metadata.notes: SMC daemon replay on M5 structure with a 1h bias series resampled from it. Fixed-fractional risk 2.00% of equity against the daemon's own stop; PnL priced from the actual exit level (100 units/lot), stop resolved intrabar and gap-filled at the open, round-trip cost 3.0 bps + 5.0 pts slippage/side. Bars stepped 5 at a time; unresolved positions time out after 100 bars. FX: quote currency USD (no conversion).
